history.summary: Q Bay Residences 3BR in Tampines/D18, priced at $1,522 PSF essentially at the $1,515 URA median, with a healthy 5.2%/yr appreciation on a deep 183-txn series. Strong-data Tampines play with CRL and Tampines Regional Centre catalysts, but the $1.95M ticket for a 3BR sits at the upper end of the OCR family band.
history.rating_rationale: 5.23%/yr URA appreciation over a robust 183 transactions is genuinely reliable and above OCR baseline (~3.7%). PSF at $1,522 vs $1,515 median is fair, not overpaying. D18 benefits from Cross Island Line + DTL extension and Tampines Regional Centre. 2017-built (good condition, ~90yrs lease) large 1281sqft 3BR. Main caveat: $1.95M is a chunky ticket for OCR, narrowing the buyer pool to families.
red_flags: $1.95M is high for an OCR 3BR — buyer pool narrows above district norms
1281sqft is generous; resale depends on family demand
catalysts: Cross Island Line (~2030) and DTL extension serving Tampines

history.summary: Low-quantum ($788k) D18/OCR 1BR priced slightly below the verified recent 1BR average on a deep cohort - modest genuine value in the strongest forward region.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,495 PSF is verified at/just below market: project 1BR average is ~$1,504-1,518 PSF and project-wide last-12-month average ~$1,504 PSF, so this is a small real discount rather than a quirk. The signal is trustworthy - 183 appreciation txns and 16 cohort txns give a solid anchor (contrast the thin names in this batch). D18 is OCR, the best verified forward region (~+4.0%), and the low $788k quantum keeps entry accessible and the buyer/tenant pool broad near Tampines St 86. No red flags. Trailing CAGR 5.23% is background only. The +3.7% vs-cohort means it is not a screaming discount, so this is a measured Buy at medium confidence - good region and clean data, but value edge is modest and yield is ordinary.
red_flags: psf_premium_vs_cohort +3.7% - priced essentially at, not below, the 1BR cohort; discount is small
527 sqft shoebox 1BR competes with abundant Tampines mass-market supply for resale/rental
catalysts: D18 (OCR) - strongest verified forward-appreciation region in the backtest
Low absolute quantum ($788k) widens the resale buyer pool and supports liquidity
